story.iWant: to maintain a separate index of verified Q&A pairs
story.soThat: approved answers are prioritized in future queries
story.tasks:
- [ ] **Task 1: Database Schema Design** (AC: #1, #3, #4) - [ ] Create `verified_qa` table with columns: id, tenant_id, group_id, bot_id, question_text, question_embedding (vector 1024), answer_text, source_citations (jsonb), approved_by_user_id, approved_at, created_at, updated_at - [ ] Add vector index on question_embedding column for fast similarity search - [ ] Implement RLS policies: `tenant_id = current_tenant() AND group_id = current_group()` - [ ] Add composite indexes: (tenant_id, group_id, bot_id) and (tenant_id, group_id) - [ ] Create Alembic migration script with rollback support
- [ ] **Task 2: Backend API Models** (AC: #1, #4) - [ ] Define SQLAlchemy model `VerifiedQA` in `apps/api/app/models/verified_qa.py` - [ ] Include relationships to User (approved_by), Bot, Group, Tenant - [ ] Add Pydantic schemas: `VerifiedQACreate`, `VerifiedQAResponse`, `VerifiedQAUpdate` - [ ] Implement validation: question_text (required, max 2000 chars), answer_text (required) - [ ] Add created_at/updated_at timestamp handling
- [ ] **Task 3: Embedding Service Integration** (AC: #2) - [ ] Add method `embed_verified_question()` to existing embedding service - [ ] Use nomic-embed-text model (same as documents) via Ollama - [ ] Return 1024-dimension vector for storage - [ ] Handle embedding errors with proper logging and retries - [ ] Verify embedding dimension matches document chunks
- [ ] **Task 4: HITL Approval Integration** (AC: #1) - [ ] Modify HITL approval endpoint to create VerifiedQA entry on approval - [ ] Extract question, answer, citations from HITL item - [ ] Generate embedding for approved question - [ ] Store with proper tenant_id, group_id, bot_id scoping - [ ] Include approved_by_user_id from authenticated user - [ ] Transaction: HITL approval + VerifiedQA creation must be atomic
- [ ] **Task 5: Basic CRUD Operations** (AC: #1, #4, #5) - [ ] Implement `create_verified_qa(db, schema)` service function - [ ] Implement `get_verified_qa_by_id(db, id)` with RLS enforcement - [ ] Implement `list_verified_qa(db, tenant_id, group_id, bot_id)` with pagination - [ ] Validate all operations respect tenant/group/bot scoping - [ ] Add proper error handling and logging
- [ ] **Task 6: Testing** (AC: all) - [ ] Unit tests: VerifiedQA model CRUD operations - [ ] Integration test: HITL approval creates VerifiedQA entry - [ ] Test RLS: verify cross-tenant/cross-group isolation - [ ] Test embedding generation and storage - [ ] Test data validation and error cases - [ ] Add test fixtures for verified_qa entries

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** a Q&A pair is approved via HITL **Then** it is stored in the Verified KB with: - Question (embedded for semantic match) - Answer (full text) - Source citations - Approved by (user) - Approved at (timestamp) - Bot ID (scoped) - Group ID (group-scoped) - Tenant ID (for RLS)
2. **Embeddings use same model as documents** (nomic-embed-text, 1024 dimensions)
3. **Verified KB is separate from document chunks** (dedicated table)
4. **All entries are scoped** by tenant_id, group_id, and bot_id for proper isolation
5. **Verified entries include full metadata** for traceability and audit compliance

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR51: System maintains a separate index of verified Q&A pairs (Golden Dataset) FR52: Approved HITL responses automatically add to Verified KB FR53: Users can manually add Q&A pairs to Verified KB FR54: Users can edit or remove entries from Verified KB FR55: Verified KB entries take priority over RAG-generated answers

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 7.1: Verified KB Storage - Maintain separate index of verified Q&A pairs with embeddings using same model as documents (nomic-embed-text). Scoped by tenant_id and bot_id. Story 7.2: Verified KB Priority - Check Verified KB FIRST before generating new answers, return with "Verified" badge Story 7.3: Manual Q&A Entry - Allow users to manually add Q&A pairs Story 7.4: Verified KB Management - Edit or remove Verified KB entries

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: RLS policies enforce tenant + group isolation at DB layer. All embeddings scoped by (tenant_id, group_id, bot_id). Use pgvector with IVFFLAT index for semantic search. Vector queries always constrain by tenant_id + group_id. Separate table for verified_qa allows different query strategies and independent lifecycle management.

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Use pgvector for embeddings with composite index (tenant_id, group_id, embedding) and IVFFlat for performance. Embedding model: nomic-embed-text via Ollama, 768 dimensions (Note: Story mentions 1024, verify actual dimension). All vector queries must constrain by tenant_id + group_id for proper isolation.

doc.title: Story 5.1: HITL Queue View
doc.snippet: HITL approval endpoint at /api/v1/hitl/queue/{id}/approve handles human review approvals. When approved, Q&A should be added to Verified KB automatically (FR52). Approval must be atomic transaction: HITL status update + Verified KB creation.

doc.title: Story 3.4: Confidence Scoring & Routing
doc.snippet: Confidence scoring includes is_verified_kb flag for tracking verified answers. Verified KB boost: answers from verified KB receive 95+ confidence score. Future integration: Check Verified KB first before RAG generation (Story 7.2).

story-context.constraints:
**Architectural Constraints:** - Verified KB must be stored in separate table from document embeddings for independent lifecycle management - All database operations must respect RLS policies with tenant_id + group_id isolation - Embedding model must be consistent: nomic-embed-text (768 dimensions, not 1024 as mentioned in story - verify with existing embeddings table) - HITL approval and VerifiedQA creation must be atomic (single database transaction)
**Data Isolation:** - Every VerifiedQA entry MUST have tenant_id, group_id, bot_id for proper multi-tenant isolation - RLS policies must enforce: tenant_id = current_tenant AND group_id = current_group - Bots in same group can share verified answers with full provenance tracking
**Vector Index Performance:** - Use IVFFLAT index on question_embedding for fast semantic search - Index tuning: lists=100 for datasets <10K vectors (default), tune in Story 7.2 for larger datasets - Composite indexes on (tenant_id, group_id, bot_id) for scoped queries
**Transaction Boundaries:** - HITL approval + VerifiedQA creation must be in same transaction to prevent orphaned approvals - Use SQLAlchemy AsyncSession transaction management
**Testing Standards:** - Unit tests for model CRUD operations and validation - Integration tests for end-to-end HITL approval → VerifiedQA creation - RLS tests must verify cross-tenant and cross-group isolation - Test data must span multiple tenants/groups

tests.standards: Testing follows pytest + pytest-asyncio for async database operations. All tests use fixtures for database session, test tenants, groups, bots, and users. RLS enforcement is verified by attempting cross-tenant/cross-group access and asserting failures. Integration tests use FastAPI TestClient with async support. Vector operations tested with sample embeddings. Transaction boundaries verified using rollback tests. Test coverage target: >80% for new code.

tests.ideas:
**AC1 - HITL Approval Creates VerifiedQA:** - Test successful HITL approval creates VerifiedQA entry with all required fields - Test embedding is generated and stored correctly (768 dimensions) - Test atomic transaction: if VerifiedQA creation fails, HITL item remains unresolved - Test with edited answer text from approval request - Test source_citations JSONB is properly stored and retrieved
**AC2 - Embedding Model Consistency:** - Test question_embedding dimension matches document embeddings (768, not 1024) - Test embedding service uses nomic-embed-text model - Test embedding normalization for cosine similarity
**AC3 - Separate Table Structure:** - Test VerifiedQA table exists and is independent of chunks/embeddings tables - Test VerifiedQA entries persist even if source documents are deleted
**AC4 - Multi-Tenant Scoping:** - Test RLS prevents Tenant A from accessing Tenant B's verified_qa entries - Test RLS prevents Group A from accessing Group B's verified_qa entries (same tenant) - Test composite index on (tenant_id, group_id, bot_id) improves query performance - Test all CRUD operations include tenant_id + group_id filters
**AC5 - Full Metadata and Traceability:** - Test approved_by_user_id references correct user - Test approved_at timestamp is set correctly - Test created_at and updated_at timestamps - Test source_citations JSONB contains document references
**Edge Cases:** - Test question_text exceeds 2000 char limit (validation error) - Test missing required fields (validation error) - Test invalid UUID references (foreign key error) - Test concurrent HITL approvals (race conditions) - Test embedding service failure (retry logic and error handling)
